UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user of the PDF Spark application, linking them to their uploaded documents and processing jobs.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: The email address of the user, used for communication and identification.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Represents a file (PDF or other formats) uploaded by a user or generated as an output from a processing job.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Document entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile that owns this document. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Document)

fileName.description: The original name of the file, including its extension.

storagePath.description: The URI or path where the file is securely stored in the backend (e.g., cloud storage path).

fileSize.description: The size of the file in bytes.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the file (e.g., 'application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document').

uploadDate.description: Timestamp when the document was initially uploaded by the user or generated by a job.

isInput.description: Indicates if this document was an initial input file provided by the user.

isOutput.description: Indicates if this document was generated as a result of a processing job.

ProcessingJob.title: ProcessingJob
ProcessingJob.description: Represents a specific operation (e.g., merge, split, convert, AI analysis) requested by a user on one or more documents.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProcessingJob entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who initiated this job. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ProcessingJob)

jobType.description: The type of PDF operation performed (e.g., 'PDF_MERGE', 'PDF_SPLIT', 'PDF_TO_WORD', 'AI_SUMMARIZE').

status.description: The current status of the processing job (e.g., 'PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the processing job was created.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the processing job was completed, if applicable.

inputDocumentIds.description: References to the Document entities that were used as input for this job. (Relationship: Document N:N ProcessingJob)

outputDocumentIds.description: References to the Document entities that were generated as output by this job. (Relationship: Document N:N ProcessingJob)

jobParameters.description: A JSON string containing job-specific parameters (e.g., page ranges for PDF split, target format for conversion, AI model settings, AI prompt).

definition.description: Stores individual user profiles. The document ID matches the Firebase Auth UID. Allows direct ownership checks: request.auth.uid == userId.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user, matching their Firebase Authentication UID.

definition.description: Stores documents uploaded or generated for a specific user. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence. All documents in this subcollection are owned by the parent user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this document.

params.name: documentId
params.description: The unique identifier for the document.

definition.description: Stores processing jobs initiated by a specific user. Includes denormalized 'userId' for authorization independence. All jobs in this subcollection are owned by the parent user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who initiated this processing job.

params.name: jobId
params.description: The unique identifier for the processing job.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for PDF Spark is designed around user-centric data, prioritizing Authorization Independence and secure List operations (QAPs).

1.  **User Profiles (`/users/{userId}`):** User profiles are stored in a top-level collection `users`, where each document ID (`userId`) directly corresponds to the Firebase Authentication UID. This makes user profile access simple and secure: `request.auth.uid == userId`.

2.  **User-Owned Documents (`/users/{userId}/documents/{documentId}`):** Documents are stored as a subcollection under the respective user's profile. Each `Document` document explicitly includes a `userId` field which is denormalized from the parent path's `userId`. This is crucial for **Authorization Independence** as it allows security rules to check `request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId` directly on the document itself, without needing `get()` calls to the parent `UserProfile` document. This also supports **QAPs (Rules are not Filters)** for document listing. A user can only list documents within their own `/users/{userId}/documents` subcollection, as the rule `allow list: if request.auth.uid == userId;` is efficient and inherently restricts queries to the authenticated user's data.

3.  **User-Owned Processing Jobs (`/users/{userId}/processingJobs/{jobId}`):** Similar to documents, processing jobs are stored as a subcollection under the user's profile. Each `ProcessingJob` document also includes a `userId` field, denormalized from the parent path. This design again ensures **Authorization Independence**, allowing rules to verify `request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId` without parent lookups, and supports **QAPs** by enabling secure `list` operations restricted to the authenticated user's jobs. The `status` field within `ProcessingJob` exemplifies **Explicit State Modeling**, making job progress clear and predictable.

This hierarchical, owner-based structure with denormalized `userId` fields in subcollection documents guarantees simple, robust, and easily debuggable security rules, adhering strictly to the core design principles by avoiding hierarchical authorization dependencies and enabling efficient, secure list queries.
